name: Piquindone
summary: Piquindone (Ro 22-1319) is an atypical antipsychotic with a tricyclic structure that was developed in the 1980s but was never marketed. It acts as a selective D2 receptor antagonist, though based on its effects profile its selectivity may be considered controversial. Unlike most other D2 receptor ligands, piquindone displays Na+-dependent binding, a property it shares with tropapride, zetidoline, and metoclopramide.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a selective D2 receptor antagonist, though based on its effects profile its selectivity may be considered controversial. Unlike most other D2 receptor ligands, piquindone displays Na+-dependent binding, a property it shares with tropapride, zetidoline, and metoclopramide.

uses.text: Piquindone (Ro 22-1319) is an atypical antipsychotic with a tricyclic structure that was developed in the 1980s but was never marketed. In clinical trials piquindone was found to possess moderate efficacy in treating positive symptoms of schizophrenia, and notably, was also modestly effective for negative symptoms, though this was just under statistical significance.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people, as it was never marketed. Drugs that block D2 receptors can cause drowsiness, restlessness, stiffness and tremor, and raise the hormone prolactin.
sideEffects.zh: 由於從未上市，人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。阻斷 D2 受體的藥物可能引起嗜睡、坐立不安、肌肉僵硬和顫抖，並使泌乳激素升高。

fact.en: Its code name Ro 22-1319 shows it came from Hoffmann-La Roche, which labels its research compounds with the letters Ro.
fact.zh: 它的代號 Ro 22-1319 顯示它出自羅氏藥廠，該公司用 Ro 這兩個字母標記研究中的化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它的代号 Ro 22-1319 显示它出自罗氏药厂，该公司用 Ro 这两个字母标记研究中的化合物。
